premises.text: Conventional battery metals are toxic and scarce, so recycling cannot scale green-energy storage far enough
premises.evidence_span: The metals that we use in our current battery tech are not only toxic, but very scarce as well

premises.text: Hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper with zinc and manganese makes rechargeable paper batteries
premises.evidence_span: We have invented what we call hydrogel-reinforced cellulose paper, and utilize zinc and manganese as the two sides of the battery

premises.text: Batteries are compostable, flex/cut-safe while operating, and stack into plug-and-play lithium replacements
Production uses existing manufacturing processes and equipment
premises.evidence_span: We used existing manufacturing processes and equipment

premises.text: Abundant materials make the batteries about ten times cheaper
premises.evidence_span: the cost of making our paper batteries isn't two times or three times cheaper, but it's 10 times cheaper

premises.text: Specialized versions target energy storage, consumer/wearables, and eventually EVs with industry partners
premises.evidence_span: we decided to come up with three versions of specialized paper batteries for a focused area of application

value.text: Safer, more sustainable, cost-efficient batteries that enable a greener energy future
value.evidence_span: a safer, more sustainable, and cost-efficient future in battery tech

causal_links.evidence_span: thanks to our proprietary tech and knowledge, we have unlocked three new features
dream of a greener future demands greener batteries
most practical solution in the market

notes: Three product features (compostable, adaptive/flexible, cut-safe) plus stackability folded into P3 per §4.1(5). Performance roadmap charts not coded as separate premises. Revenue projections excluded. Partner names kept only as support for application-focus premise.
